pluss::subsp::stats::ts::plot_acf¶

Draws the autocorrelation plot of a series into a pluss::pl::Studio figure.

Signature¶

pluss::pl::Studio& ts::plot::acf(pluss::pl::Studio& studio, const pluss::Series& x, const ts::plot::CorrPlotOptions& options = {}, pluss::codem::Config cfg = {});

What It Does¶

Adds stems for the autocorrelation at each lag, the two lines of the white-noise band (+CI, −CI) and a zero line, with the axes labelled lag and the function’s name. Bars outside the band point to structure. The figure is returned for chaining and can then be saved with save_svg, save_pdf or save_png.

Parameters¶

pluss::pl::Studio& studio

The figure to draw into.

const pluss::Series& x

The series (a vector), at least two observations.

const ts::plot::CorrPlotOptions& options

Lags, estimator and band; see CorrPlotOptions.

pluss::codem::Config cfg

Output configuration of the payload arrays.

Returns¶

The same Studio, for chaining.

Errors¶

  • A series shorter than two observations is rejected.

Practical Examples¶

Example 1¶

Draw the autocorrelation plot of an autoregressive series and save it.

#include <pluss/ma.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include <pluss/pl/studio.h>

namespace ts = pluss::subsp::stats::ts;
using pluss::Series;

const auto f64 = pluss::Config{}.with_dtype(pluss::ScalarType::Float64);
void show(const char* label, const Series& s) {
  std::cout << std::left << std::setw(14) << label << std::right << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4);
  for (double v : s.host<double>()) std::cout << std::setw(9) << v;
  std::cout << "\n";
}
std::vector<double> noise(int n) {
  std::vector<double> e(n);
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    double u = std::sin(12.9898 * (i + 1.0) + 78.233) * 43758.5453;
    u -= std::floor(u);
    e[i] = u - 0.5;
  }
  return e;
}
Series ar1(int n, double phi) {
  const auto e = noise(n);
  std::vector<double> x(n);
  double carry = 0.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    carry = phi * carry + e[i];
    x[i] = carry;
  }
  return pluss::make_series(x, {n}, f64);
}
Series walk(int n) {
  const auto e = noise(n);
  std::vector<double> x(n);
  double sum = 0.0;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    sum += e[i];
    x[i] = sum;
  }
  return pluss::make_series(x, {n}, f64);
}

int main() {
  const Series y = ar1(400, 0.7);
  ts::plot::CorrPlotOptions options;
  options.max_lag = 24;
  pluss::pl::Studio figure("acf", pluss::pl::Theme::paper());
  ts::plot::acf(figure, y, options);
  const char* dir = std::getenv("PLUSSMA_GUIDE_ASSETS");
  if (dir != nullptr) figure.save_svg(std::string(dir) + "/ts_acf.svg");
  std::cout << "figure drawn with " << options.max_lag << " lags\n";
}

Output

figure drawn with 24 lags
